name: grand_totals_with_kpi_ratios
purpose: Summarize the main like-for-like trading result and the core basket and pricing KPIs in one-row outputs for the four comparable branches.
intent: Run separate one-row grand total queries, each filtered to the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 using branch filtering that covers 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Query 1: [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], and [revenue growth %], no grouping. Query 2: [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], and [QTY GROWTH %], no grouping. Query 3: [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], and [bills growth %], no grouping. Query 4: [retail price current year], [retail price past year], and [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], no grouping. Query 5: [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], no grouping. Query 6: [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], no grouping.
dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW(
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %]
    ),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
)

name: new_branch_cfh022_current_only
purpose: Show the current-period contribution of the new branch CFH022 separately from like-for-like performance.
intent: Run separate one-row queries filtered to only 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] = CFH022 and also apply the same branch filter value to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Query 1: [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], and [revenue Growth], no grouping. Query 2: [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], and [QTY Growth], no grouping. Query 3: [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], and [bills growth], no grouping. Query 4: [UPDATED_DATE], no grouping. This is for current-only branch reporting, so no percentage should be requested if the prior value is zero.
dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW(
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth]
    ),
    TREATAS({"CFH022"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH022"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH022"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH022"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
)

name: comparable_monthly_trend
purpose: Show how like-for-like revenue, quantity and bills have moved over the available months, with the most recent dates first.
intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date] for the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, with the same branch filter also applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], and [bills growth %]. Limit to 15 rows sorted by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date] DESCENDING.
dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    CALCULATETABLE(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date],
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "net bills PAST", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %]
        ),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
    ),
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date], DESC
)

name: category_risk_summary
purpose: Measure breadth of category decline and the sales weight of those declining categories, which are both needed for category health reporting.
intent: Run separate one-row queries for the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, with the same branch filter also applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Query 1: [COUNT], [COUNT_TOTAL], [COUNT_PLUS], and [COUNT %], no grouping. Query 2: [sum deg cur rev], [sum deg past rev], [sum total cur rev], [sum total past rev], [contribution cur], and [contribution past], no grouping. These use the model’s own category measures from CAT_TABLE rather than rebuilding category logic from raw columns.
dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE (
    ROW (
        "COUNT", [COUNT],
        "COUNT_TOTAL", [COUNT_TOTAL],
        "COUNT_PLUS", [COUNT_PLUS],
        "COUNT %", [COUNT %]
    ),
    TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no] ),
    TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no] ),
    TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] ),
    TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] )
)
